description: Test scores reported by the original implementation of the two studies (reports of 2025, preserved in the git history at commit 6dcb369). They are the numbers as reported: AUDIT.md lists the errors behind them.

lstm_dropout.note: the model also tied the input and output embeddings

lstm_dropout_adamw.note: AdamW was applied to the model without dropout

wt_vd_ntavsgd.note: trigger without the non-monotone interval, average of per-epoch snapshots, selection on the SGD weights

bilstm_dropout.note: the dropout before the intent layer was applied after the intent logits

bert.note: best configuration of a hyperparameter search; the code was never committed

notes: LM: one run per configuration. ATIS LSTM models: mean over 5 runs, each tested with the weights of its last epoch. Hyperparameters differ in part from the audited study (see the paper, Section 3).
